id.description: A unique identifier for the call park.

name.description: Unique name for the call park. The maximum length is 80.

recall.description: Recall options that are added to call park.

agents.description: People, workspaces and virtual lines that are eligible to receive calls.

parkOnAgentsEnabled.description: Whether or not the calls will be parked on agents as a destination.

callParkExtensions.description: Array of call park extensions assigned to a call park.
